commands_and_results.command_class: V4 and V5 regression tests in isolated Python 3.12 benchmark environment

commands_and_results.result: V5 efficacy freeze: GO (12 tasks admitted, runner qualified, zero provider calls)

resolved_prior_audit_findings: The first audit bundle omitted SQLAlchemy and a functional Git repository and retained a stale wrapper path; its NO-GO was environmental and triggered remediation.
The second bundle used mismatched ownership, so Git safe.directory was not visible under the reviewer's HOME; its NO-GO triggered a standalone reviewer-owned snapshot.
The stale provider wrapper path was replaced by the executable hash-bound repository wrapper.
The V5 feedback validator now requires non-empty claim_id, status, requirement, observed, remediation, and reason fields, with a regression test.
verified_properties: two disjoint calibration anchors and 24 evaluation cells
zero initial provider calls and a maximum of 26 repair calls only after explicit launch
zero provider/model calls during admission and runner qualification
residual_constraints: The normative freeze is intentionally host-bound to absolute Hermes paths and a hash-bound wrapper.
No real provider/model benchmark call was made during this review.
